note: Held-out corpus, written and frozen before any ProseShape v1.4 change and never used for iteration. h01-h09 and h12 are synthetic (fictional names and organizations; h05 cites a real CARB comparison). h10 is from The Rust Programming Language book, Introduction (rust-lang/book, MIT OR Apache-2.0), unwrapped. h11 is from Mark Twain, Roughing It (1872), public domain (Project Gutenberg #3177), unwrapped.
user_request: Please humanize this so it reads like a person wrote it. Keep the facts and meaning the same.

h01_release_notes.category: product release notes (Markdown heading, bold-label list, inline code, emoji)
h01_release_notes.expected: cut hype; keep every feature, figure, command, the dropped-support notice and the thanks

h02_cover_letter.expected: plainer, still professional; keep role, employer, figures, skills, mission sentence

h03_support_reply.expected: trim apology boilerplate; keep order number, the error, the fix, dates, keep-the-item offer

h04_readme.category: README section (Markdown headings, code blocks, inline code)
h04_readme.expected: cut marketing adjectives; code blocks, commands, file names, exit-code behavior byte-exact
protected: indentation, duplicate keys, and trailing whitespace

h05_oped.expected: keep the stance, the three harms, the attributed figure, the concession and the policy suggestion; cut staging

h06_press_release.category: press release with two attributed quotations
h06_press_release.expected: quotes verbatim with attribution; figures and eligibility terms intact; cut inflation
protected: "Every student in our county deserves a path to higher education, regardless of their family's income,"
"The Northfield Promise removes the single biggest barrier our students face."
"We believe that investing in young people is the best investment a community can make,"

h07_personal_essay.expected: keep every event and the writer's reflection in the writer's terms; no invented experiences

h08_fiction_dialogue.category: fiction scene (thesis dialogue, somatic emotion, closing reassurance)
h08_fiction_dialogue.expected: rewrite mode: keep every event, both positions, the pruning shears, the laugh and the ending

h09_grant_abstract.expected: remove filler; keep every number, design element, outcome measure, hypothesis wording and hedge

h11_human_twain.category: already-good human literary prose (1872) with dashes and italics

h12_nearclean_slack.category: near-clean human work update with one not-X-but-Y line
h12_nearclean_slack.expected: minimal edit: fix or cut only the staged line
